text: FULL CLOSE REASON (the close call's reason was accidentally overwritten with 'd5tj duplicate close' by a redundant second close invocation — this comment is the record): Fixed: cargo clippy -p lichen-gateway --lib -- -D warnings passes on clippy 1.96.
